page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i2ne.8xlarge is a storage and memory-optimized virtual machine delivered via KVM virtualization. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs across 16 physical cores and 32 threads, driven by a 2.5 GHz Intel Xeon 8163 processor based on the x86_64 architecture. The platform includes a 33 MB L3 cache, support for AVX and AVX-512 extensions, 256 GB of system memory delivering 8 GB per vCPU, and a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps. A core characteristic of this configuration is its integrated 7679 GB local SSD storage, eliminating the reliance on remote network volumes for primary data operations.

Benchmark outcomes show distinct multi-threaded and local throughput advantages counterbalanced by lower single-core execution metrics. Synthetic evaluation places single-core performance in lower percentiles, evidenced by a Geekbench single-core score of 946.0 and stress-ng single-core rating of 1106.68. In contrast, multi-threaded tasks achieve mid-tier outcomes, registering 23463.4 in multi-core stress-ng, 8432.0 in Geekbench multi-core, and 23.13 million operations per second in Redis SET operations. Memory throughput achieves 77.33 GB/sec uncached large-block reads and 46.98 GB/sec writes, supporting steady memory-bound and multi-core computation.

Hardware tradeoffs center around processor generation versus dense onboard capacity. While the older Intel Xeon architecture exhibits lower clock frequency and reduced single-thread compression efficiency, it balances this by coupling 256 GB of system RAM directly with 7679 GB of high-capacity local SSD storage. This resource density makes the instance cost-effective for I/O-heavy applications where external network storage latency and remote egress overhead present operational bottlenecks.

Appropriate deployment scenarios include persistent transactional databases, distributed NoSQL datastores, Redis caching clusters with local replication, static web delivery engines, and large-scale extract, transform, load pipelines that process massive datasets locally.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i2ne.8xlarge is an x86_64 storage-oriented instance equipped with 32 dedicated vCPUs from an Intel Xeon 8163 processor clocked at 2.5 GHz, 256 GB of RAM, and 7679 GB of integrated local SSD storage. It provides a 10 Gbps baseline network bandwidth without discrete GPUs. While single-threaded computational metrics reflect lower baseline clock speeds, multi-threaded performance is consistent across parallel workloads, evidenced by 23.13 million operations per second on Redis SET benchmarks and solid multi-core stress execution. The pairing of an 8:1 memory-to-core ratio with expansive local storage reduces reliance on networked block storage. This instance is suited for heavy transactional databases, distributed data processing, in-memory caching systems, and high-throughput static data serving.
